attributes.residual: LoadWorldDone real 15, insns T84/O85, opcode multiset DIFFERS with ours-only '-1 mr' -- a SINGLE extra register copy, and NOT branch shape. Aligned read at fn+0x1c: the target writes the low half of the address directly into its destination saved register, 'addi r28,r3,0 @lbl_8028C9A8(ADDR16_LO)'; ours homes it in r0 first, 'addi r0,r3,0 @lbl_8028C9A8(ADDR16_LO)' at 0x1c followed by 'mr r28,r0' at 0x20. This is the ADDR16_LO-homed-via-r0 mechanism verbatim, making LoadWorldDone a FOURTH instance beyond the three named in the addr16 lane's claim. gauntworld.c::LoadWorldData is a FIFTH, identical in kind: 'addi r0,r3,0 @lbl_80257680(ADDR16_LO)' then 'mr r31,r0' at 0x20 against the target's direct 'addi r27,r3,0 @LO' (real 43, T85/O86, ours-only '-1 mr'). DO NOT PROBE either from a control-flow or decl-order lane: the mechanism is recorded source-unreachable across ~10 axes and is under active forensic study by work_claim.addr16lo-forensics.20260831.v1, whose contrast-census method is the only approach with a live hypothesis. These two are handed off as fresh instances in TUs (world.c, gauntworld.c) that lane is not currently working, which makes them useful independent samples for its discriminant search.
